title: quadlet: fix rootless template dependency translation for rootful templates
body:
Fix rootless Quadlet generator failure when a rootless templated unit
contains a dependency (e.g., Conflicts=) that points to a rootful
templated Quadlet unit.

The translateUnitDependencies function only looked up dependencies in
unitsInfoMap, which contains only units found in rootless directories.
When a rootless unit referenced a rootful template (e.g., test1@.container
in /etc/containers/systemd), the lookup failed with "unable to translate
dependency for %s".

For template units not in unitsInfoMap, compute the service name from the
filename using GetUnitServiceName. Template units only need the service
name for dependency translation, not the resource name, so this approach
is safe and preserves existing strict behavior for non-template units.

Fixes #29819
